name: preset-mcp-skills
description: Preset MCP skills for the Preset MCP gateway and Superset MCP tool workflows only. Do not use for direct API work.

interface.longDescription: Markdown skills for agents using the Preset MCP gateway and Superset MCP tools. Use only when the user asks for MCP, MCP tools, MCP clients, Superset MCP, or Preset MCP workflows, including connecting a client and choosing a workspace. Do not use for direct Preset Management API, Superset REST API, other direct APIs, curl, Python requests, exports, or database calls. If MCP cannot satisfy the request, stop and explain the missing MCP capability; do not switch surfaces unless the user explicitly starts a direct API workflow.
capabilities: Connect to the Preset MCP gateway
